title: Concert harp D4, soft pluck
author: Versilian Studios LLC; performer K. Smith; FreePats assembled by Roberto
modifications: Single complete recorded pluck, trim leading silence, gentle amplitude normalization, short edge fades; no synthetic replacement. Four beats pitch-resample this real note into a major arpeggio.
runtimeNotes: Harp D4-F#4-A4-D5; guitar C4-E4-G4-C5. Each beat uses actual recorded note resampled with pitch-preserving time stretch disabled. Slow/fast changes beat spacing, soft/strong changes volume.
